faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Kangra District Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the Kangra District Recruitment 2026 is 14th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned office by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in Kangra District Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The Kangra District is recruiting for the posts of Tehsildar, Naib-Tehsildar, and Patwari. These positions are available on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required for these posts is a graduate degree. Additionally, candidates must have at least 5 years of service in the revenue department of Himachal Pradesh.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 65 years. There is no minimum age specified in the provided details.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Kangra District Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it via post to the Deputy Commissioner, Kangra at Dharamshala.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for the recruited candidates?
faq.answer: The salary varies by post: Tehsildar will receive ₹ 70,000/-, Naib-Tehsildar will receive ₹ 60,000/-, and Patwari will receive ₹ 40,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any specific details regarding fees.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on the recommendation of a committee. Further details about the selection stages are not explicitly provided.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is contract-based. This means the positions are temporary and for a specified period.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Kangra District. Links are provided in the "Important Links" section of this article.
